text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali on Thursday chaired a cabinet meeting on external trade, corporate modernisation, road safety, and the preparation of the 9th development plan for 1997-2001.
- Tunisian and Algerian businessmen on Thursday held a meeting in the Tunisian border village of Sakiet Sidi Youssef to boost cooperation.
- A cabinet meeting on Thursday approved a draft for a new code for road safety.
- Communications ministry sets technical specifications for cordless phone use.
- President on Thursday had phone call with Libyan leader Muammar Ghaddafi on bilateral relations and Maghreb and Middle East issues.
